messages.subject: Caption and cross reference with grid.arrange
parts:
Hello group!

I'm trying to produce a grid of plots (in ggplot2), arranged with grid.arrange, with caption in the chunk statement (also I try in grid.arrange), to finally be able to do cross-reference in the text.... No clue why is not working. I tried different approaches.

Thanks in advance!

The reproducible Rmd file, as follow:
---
output:
  pdf_document:
    fig_caption: yes
    number_sections: false
  html_document:  
    df_print: paged


---

```{r study21,  warnings=F, message = F, echo = F, include = T, eval = T, fig.caption="Hello world!"}
library(ggplot2)
library(gridExtra)
library(grid)
grid.arrange(qplot(mpg, wt, data = mtcars, colour = cyl), qplot(mpg, data = mtcars, bins =10) + ggtitle("title"), bottom="What about now?" , nrow = 1)
```

\ref{fig:study21} \ref{tab:study21}
